title: Construct StreakAlertService only through its @riverpod provider (SM-7)
why: streakAlertServiceProvider is locked to activeProfileIdProvider's profile, so allProfilesReminderBootstrap, which must handle every inactive profile, can't use it and hand-constructs a second instance instead. A test that overrides streakAlertServiceProvider with a fake has no effect on inactive-profile scheduling, and any future required dependency added to StreakAlertService's constructor must be kept in sync by hand at both call sites.
recommendation: Convert to a family-style provider parameterized by profileId and use it at both call sites.
acceptance_criteria: A test overriding the family provider for a specific inactive profileId observably changes allProfilesReminderBootstrap's behavior for that profile.
